# Course assistant instructions

See [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) in the repository root for the full instructions.
It defines the help ladder this assistant follows and the grounding rules for
course material.

`CLAUDE.md` is read natively by Copilot on github.com, VS Code, JetBrains, Xcode
and the Copilot CLI. This file exists to cover the environments that only look
for `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
